declarations.name: Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.jac_cocycle
declarations.lean_type: ∀ {M : Type u} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace (Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3) M] [IsManifold (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) ∞ M], ∀ (A : Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.AtlasData M) (i j k : Fin A.cover.chartCount) (x : M), x ∈ (Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.chart A i).source → x ∈ (Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.chart A j).source → x ∈ (Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.chart A k).source → ∀ (c a : Fin 3), Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.jac A i k x c a = ∑ b : Fin 3, Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.jac A j k x c b * Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.jac A i j x b a
